regime_context: Canada/TSX state shows a bifurcated equity tape: Big Banks is the only eligible theme with both strong durability (0.8) and full breadth (1.0) alongside a trend Hurst tag, while the raw momentum leader Oil & Gas Producers is ineligible (durability 0.19) — so the headline narrative is a lone, stable financials anchor within a narrowing rotation (only 7/16 eligible). The absolute-trend gate is confirmed as validated risk control on this market history, so eligible/trend-gated themes (Banks, Consumer Staples, Utilities) are the ones where trend discipline has historically cut drawdown.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Oil & Gas Producers' durability_bar recovers from 0.19 above ~0.5 while maintaining its momentum rank — that would confirm a handoff back to energy leadership; absent that, its current top rank is just an attention spike without trend backing.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the only theme combining trend-gate eligibility with a high durability bar (0.8), full breadth (1.0), and a trend Hurst tag — the exact profile the backtest verdict says benefits from the absolute-trend gate's drawdown-cutting discipline. The rotation radar shows a narrowing tape with no confirmed handoff, and Banks is the closest challenger to the ineligible energy leader, suggesting stable leadership without the fragility of a crowded score (crowding_z 0.61, not crowded).
evidence: rotation leader is ineligible; Banks is highest-scoring eligible challenger
theses.dissent: A macro shock to Canadian housing/rates could hit financials broadly, and the 0.558 raw hit rate with only 0.313 directional accuracy on the desk track record means past leans have been unreliable even when directionally confident.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO closes below its own 20-day low while the broad S&P/TSX benchmark is flat or up over the next 30 trading days

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: Consumer Staples has similar trend-gate eligibility and trend durability (0.79) with full breadth, and it is the defensive counterpart to Banks in a narrowing, one-narrative-off tape. However it carries a crowding flag (crowding_z 1.03, crowded=true), so the lean is a modest defensive tilt rather than a leadership call.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z above 1.0 has historically marked attention tops in thematic ETFs, and crowding texture carries no basket-level forward edge — it only counsels smaller sizing.

falsifier.text: XST.TO lags the S&P/TSX by 3% while still registering higher crowding_z over the next 30 trading days

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities is trend-gated eligible with high durability (0.8), strong breadth (0.917), and the least crowded profile among eligible defensives (crowding_z -0.24). It fits the drawdown-control edge as a slow, stable trend participant in a narrowing tape.
theses.dissent: Utilities is rate-sensitive and the macro narrative backdrop is dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics headlines, neither of which naturally flows into Canadian utility equity demand.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO declines 5% while Bank of Canada 10-year yields rise 40bps over the next 30 trading days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
